question: Should maintainers accept this additional serial SQLite crash-recovery coverage after the branch is refreshed against current `main`?
rationale: The patch changes test-harness cost and reliability coverage rather than product behavior, and the protected maintainer label requires an explicit maintainer judgment instead of automated cleanup.

options.title: Review and merge after refresh
options.body: Rebase or update the branch, confirm the focused serial reliability proof remains stable, then merge the bounded coverage addition.

options.title: Keep the broader issue separate
options.body: Merge only this coverage if desired, while retaining the linked issue for the underlying snapshot durability and identity implementation work.

recommendation.title: Review and merge after refresh
recommendation.body: Rebase or update the branch, confirm the focused serial reliability proof remains stable, then merge the bounded coverage addition.
